executive_summary: Maven build failed with 22 compilation errors. The primary issue is that a custom Column class conflicts with JPA's @Column annotation, causing type conversion errors across multiple entity classes. Additionally, there are method signature mismatches and missing setter methods.

errors.message: incompatible types: Column cannot be converted to java.lang.annotation.Annotation (19 occurrences across Column.java, Task.java, User.java)
errors.root_cause: Custom Column entity class name conflicts with JPA @Column annotation. The compiler is attempting to use the custom Column class where @Column annotation is expected, causing type incompatibility across all entity classes that use @Column annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Rename the custom Column entity class to a non-conflicting name such as 'BoardColumn', 'TaskColumn', or 'ColumnEntity'. Update all references to this class throughout the codebase including repositories, services, controllers, and data stores.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int,String
errors.root_cause: TaskController is calling getUserTasks with 4 parameters (userId, page, size, sortBy) but TaskService interface defines getUserTasks with only 2 parameters (Long userId, Pageable pageable). The controller is not constructing a Pageable object from the pagination parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: In TaskController.getUserTasks method, create a Pageable object using PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sortBy)) and pass it to taskService.getUserTasks(userId, pageable) instead of passing individual pagination parameters.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime) (2 occurrences at lines 41 and 56)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryColumnDataStore is calling setLastUpdated() method on Column entity, but the Column class does not have this setter method defined. This indicates the Column entity is missing the lastUpdated field and its corresponding setter.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add a 'lastUpdated' field of type LocalDateTime to the Column entity class along with its getter and setter methods. Alternatively, if using Lombok, ensure @Data or @Setter annotation is present on the Column class.

errors.message: Build failed during compilation phase preventing test execution
errors.root_cause: Compilation errors prevented the build from reaching the test phase. The maven-compiler-plugin failed with 22 errors, causing the entire build to fail before tests could run.
errors.fix_recommendation: Fix the compilation errors above first. Once compilation succeeds, the build will proceed to test execution phase. Priority order: 1) Rename Column class, 2) Fix TaskController method signature, 3) Add setLastUpdated method to Column entity.
